series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2023, the number of people with disabilities employed will triple due to AI and emerging technologies, reducing barriers to access.
entries.subject: Employment of people with disabilities
entries.metric: change in number of people with disabilities employed

entries.quote: By 2024, AI identification of emotions will influence more than half of the online advertisements you see.
entries.subject: Emotion AI in advertising
entries.metric: share of online advertisements influenced by AI emotion identification

entries.quote: Through 2023, 30% of IT organizations will extend BYOD policies with “bring your own enhancement” (BYOE) to address augmented humans in the workforce.
entries.subject: Bring your own enhancement (BYOE)
entries.metric: share of IT organizations extending BYOD policies to BYOE

entries.quote: By 2025, 50% of people with a smartphone but without a bank account will use a mobile-accessible cryptocurrency account.
entries.subject: Mobile cryptocurrency for the unbanked
entries.metric: share of unbanked smartphone owners using a mobile cryptocurrency account

entries.quote: By 2023, a self-regulating association for oversight of AI and machine learning designers will be established in at least four of the G7 countries.
entries.subject: AI designer self-regulation
entries.metric: number of G7 countries with a self-regulating AI designer oversight association

entries.quote: By 2023, 40% of professional workers will orchestrate their business application experiences and capabilities like they do their music streaming experience.
entries.subject: Orchestrated application experiences
entries.metric: share of professional workers orchestrating application experiences

entries.quote: By 2023, up to 30% of world news and video content will be authenticated as real by blockchain countering deep fake technology.
entries.subject: Blockchain authentication of news
entries.metric: share of world news and video content authenticated by blockchain

entries.quote: Through 2021, digital transformation initiatives will take large traditional enterprises on average twice as long and cost twice as much as anticipated.
entries.subject: Digital transformation overruns
entries.metric: time and cost of digital transformation vs anticipated

entries.quote: By 2023, individual activities will be tracked digitally by an “Internet of Behavior” to influence benefit and service eligibility for 40% of people worldwide.
entries.subject: Internet of Behavior
entries.metric: share of people worldwide whose benefit and service eligibility is influenced by tracked activity

entries.quote: By 2024, the World Health Organization will identify online shopping as an addictive disorder, as millions abuse digital commerce and encounter financial stress.
entries.subject: Online shopping addiction
entries.note: The WHO identifies online shopping as an addictive disorder.

notes: Edition covers '2020 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions. Client report: "Gartner's Top Strategic Predictions for 2020 and Beyond: Technology Changes the Human Condition" (paywalled). gartner.com returns 403 to scripted fetches; text read from the Internet Archive snapshot listed in sources. Gartner's URL slug has the date as 2019-22-10; the dateline is October 22, 2019. The release also states a supporting prediction under the blockchain news item (by 2021, at least 10 major news organizations use blockchain to prove authenticity). Not captured as a top prediction. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
